content: mediasoup-client v3 detectDevice: iOS (any browser, AppleWebKit>=605) -> Safari12 handler; Android Chrome >=111 -> Chrome111. Producer codec defaults to first router codec the browser supports (router order VP8 then H264 in sfu.sideby.me), override via produce({codec}) picking from device.rtpCapabilities.codecs. H264 requires profile-level-id/packetization-mode params on router.
